rpc.reason: HTTP 200 with matching chain identity after observed transient TLS/path timeout; clients may retry this endpoint but must surface RPC_TRANSIENT_TLS_FAILURE separately from Wallet or Product Session state.

evmRpc.reason: HTTPS health answered and eth_chainId returned 0x1917. The endpoint has no separate public version route; identity is observed from its public health response and JSON-RPC chain check.

rest.reason: HTTPS health answered with YNX Testnet identity. /version returns 405, so health is the observed identity route.

walletGateway.reason: Public health and version were previously 200 with identity; a repeat health probe had an SSL timeout. Standard Wallet Connection must remain independent while first-party private services show Gateway degradation.

appGateway.reason: Public version request returned a Vercel deployment-not-found response; no consumer may treat this as an available Product Session service.

faucet.reason: Exact P0-093 artifact is deployed. Public health/version returned 200/no-store with matching identity; a canonical ynx1 request created one 100 YNXT transaction, independently resolved by chain REST and Explorer indexer. Wallet platform Faucet flows remain separately unverified.

indexer.reason: Health answered with matching identity, but the repeat version request had a TLS timeout; monitor before treating indexer-dependent UX as live.

minimumClientVersion.policy: A product must reject itself only when its own accepted release matrix declares a minimum version; unknown values may not be invented.

fallbacks.reason: No same-chain verified fallback endpoint is currently proven. Clients must fail closed for unavailable endpoints and may retry only the declared origin.

integrity.canonicalization: UTF-8 JSON.stringify(parsed manifest with integrity omitted)

remoteSignature.reason: No protected remote manifest signing key is available in Integration. Consumers may use only this bundled, hash-pinned manifest; remote manifest replacement remains forbidden until an independent protected signer is registered.

clientPolicy.bundledManifestFallback: this exact accepted hash-pinned manifest only until expiry; remote replacement requires protected-signature verification
clientPolicy.endpointUse: A consumer may use an endpoint only when its endpointStates status is VERIFIED or DEGRADED under the stated retry/degradation rule. UNAVAILABLE and PENDING endpoints must not be called.
clientPolicy.failover: same-chain verified endpoints only; this manifest currently declares no fallback.

acceptanceBoundary: ACCEPTED means this schema, exact HTTPS locations, chain identity, degradation semantics and bundled integrity rule are safe as a consumer contract. Faucet daemon health/version plus one canonical public funding transaction are verified, but Wallet platform Faucet flows remain unverified. It does not mean every endpoint, product API, installed client, remote signer or aggregate public deployment is healthy.
